text: My lord, the blacksmith has sent us a great bear pelt and a pair of iron claws. The quartermaster sets them down with care. "He says they will not be finished until they have torn through many of our enemies, as Ursun's own claws once did. We should carry them on our travels until then, my lord."
The Ursire Set

My lord, the blacksmith has sent us a harness of wyrm scale and a long iron spike. The quartermaster runs a hand over the scales. "He says the set was made to hunt the great beasts of the north, and it will not be finished until enough enemies have fallen to it. We should carry it on our travels until then, my lord."
Wyrm Killer Set

My lord, the blacksmith has sent us a brazier of black iron, its coals still glowing though no one has fed them. The quartermaster keeps a careful distance from the heat. "He says Dazh's fire will not burn true until it has been fed with the lives of many enemies. We should carry it on our travels until then, my lord."
The Eternal Brazier

The blacksmith has sent some strange armour to our quartermaster. It seems to breathe softly, and when someone comes close it stirs and sniffs at them. The blacksmith says that to complete it, we must bathe it in the blood of many enemies. We should fulfil his request on our journey, my lord. Perhaps it will prove useful to us.
Giving Life To The Armour

My lord, the blacksmith sends us some strange armour again. A strange shape that seems forged from chains and scraps of troll skin appears before you. "This armour fills anyone who comes near it with dread." The quartermaster continues: "He told us that we must kill enemies with this armour nearby so it can take their souls. We should take it on our travels to finish it, my lord."
Binding Souls To The Armour

My lord, the blacksmith sends us an unfinished sword this time. He wishes us to slay Northmen or Chaos daemons with it, to imbue it with the spirit of cold. The blade looks more like a shard of solid glass than steel. Just looking at it sends an icy shiver down your spine. The quartermaster continues: "He told us the blade will be complete once enough enemies have fallen to it. We should take it on our travels to finish it, my lord."
The Soul Of Frost
